title: AnyTech365
description: anytech365.com zoominfo.com/c/anytech365/368510725 AnyTech365 (Anteco Systems, S.L.) is a Spanish IT security and remote tech support company founded in 2014 by Danish entrepreneur Janus R. Nielsen, headquartered in Marbella, Spain, operating in 25+ countries with 250–400 employees. The company generates estimated annual revenue of $17–21M (2024) and was valued at $200–220M in a 2023 SPAC merger deal with Zalatoris Acquisition Corp. (NYSE: TCOA) involving $172.5M in financing. Its flagship products include IntelliGuard (AI-powered protection), AntiScam, and SystemCleaner, sold via subscription to consumers and small businesses. It ranked 27th in the FT 1000 fastest-growing European companies (2019)
